props.text: Sixty thousand Runge-Kutta steps of the Lorenz system from (1, 1, 20) trace its butterfly at *ρ* = 28. On the GPU, each of those points then moves on with the system at the slider's *ρ*: neighbours drift apart, as chaos does, but stay on the butterfly. Slide *ρ* below about 24.7 and every point spirals into one of two fixed points. Drag the 3D view to orbit it; sparks run along the orbit in time order. Shift-drag across the projection to brush a region: the 3D view keeps those points lit, and the histogram counts their speeds.
